19.en: Make sure the sealant is continuously squeezed out along the edges of the contact surfaces.
19.zh: 确保封严胶沿接触面边缘不断挤出。

19.en: Components replacement are not available for the landing gear retraction system and the applicable indication system in this recommended list.
19.zh: 在此推荐清单中，起落架收放系统和适用的指示系统没有可更换的部件。

19.en: Make sure that the AC CONNECTED and NOT IN USE lights on the P36 panel are illuminated.
19.zh: 确保P36面板上的“交流已连接”及“未使用”指示灯点亮。

19.en: Examine the flow control orifice and make sure the restrictor holes are free from blockage and contamination.
19.zh: 检查流量控制孔，确保节流孔无堵塞和污染。

19.en: Relatively simple units may not require description and operation, and/or troubleshooting information.
19.zh: 对相对简单的部件可能不需要描述和操作说明、和/或排故信息。

19.en: For Handbooks that are not FAA Approved Airplane Flight Manuals, make the following statements.
19.zh: 对非FAA批准的飞机飞行手册，做如下声明。

19.en: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be indicated on the wiring diagram.
19.zh: 在某些情况下，导线是以颜色编码的，这些情况应在接线图上标明。

19.en: Airworthiness Directive is procedure that must be used when performing maintenance on an aircraft.
19.zh: 适航指令是从事飞机进行维修时必须使用的程序。

19.en: Write only one instruction in each sentence unless two or more actions occur at the same time.
19.zh: 每句话仅写一条指令，除非有两个或更多的动作同时发生。

19.en: All Supplements may be issued to all owners of the airplane model covered by the Handbook.
19.zh: 所有补充材料都可以发给手册所涵盖的飞机机型的全部所有者。

19.en: Do not remove dowel pins unless required in complying with Continuing Airworthiness Inspection Number 5340-04.
19.zh: 不要拆卸定位销，除非符合持续适航检查编号5340-04的要求。

19.en: The position of the word in the sentence will tell you its function and its meaning, because verbs and adjectives have different positions.
19.zh: 单词在句子中的位置可以告诉你它的功能以及它的意思，因为动词和形容词有不同的位置。

20.en: The exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit.
20.en2: The exit doors are only used for evacuation.

20.en: Do the troubleshooting procedure to find the cause of the malfunction.
20.en2: According to the procedure, perform the troubleshooting to solve the cause of the malfunction.

20.en: This procedure explains how to recognize impending problems and what to do if malfunctions occur.
20.zh: 此程序解释如何识别迫在眉睫的问题以及如果发生故障该怎么处理。

20.en: It is not permitted to work with any uncontrolled technical document for maintenance work.
20.zh: 禁止使用任何非受控的技术文件去做维修工作。

20.en: This procedure shows the inspection instruction of the sixth stage low pressure bleed air blade.
20.zh: 这个程序给出了第六级低压引气叶片的检查说明。

20.en: A surge tank drain check valve is on the outboard fuel tank end rib in main tank 1 and main tank 2.
20.zh: 通气油箱排放单向活门是在1号和2号主油箱外侧油箱端部肋上。

20.en: During approach to the runway, deviation pointers in the course indicators give commands to fly up or down and left or right.
20.zh: 在向跑道进近中，航道指示器的偏离指针提供向上或向下和向左或向右飞的指令。

20.en: A separate shading pattern to distinguish between supply, pressure, return, etc., shall be used. The same coding for each individual system shall be used throughout the manual.
20.zh: 应使用单独的阴影模式来区分供应、压力、返回等。每个单独的系统应在整个手册中使用相同的编码。

20.en: Fig.1 in pages 11 and 12 are typical plating/skin illustrations as specified in System Chapters 53,54, 55 and 57.
20.zh: 第11和12页中的图1是53章、54章、55章和57章中典型的镀层/蒙皮插图。

20.en: The Check List may also contain supplemental information pertinent to the operation of the airplane, such as performance data, optional equipment operation, etc., that the pilot might routinely use.
20.zh: 检查单还可能包含与飞机操作相关的补充信息，如性能数据、可选设备操作等，飞行员可能会经常使用。

20.en: If the Check List lists "engine run-up", the amplified procedures would explain how to perform the run-up.
20.zh: 如果检查单中包含“发动机试车”检查项，扩展程序将解释如何实施试车。

20.en: Environmental Systems section shall contain information necessary for safe operation of Oxygen Systems, including capacity and duration.
20.zh: “环境系统”一节应包括安全操作氧气系统时的必要信息，如容量和持续时间。

20.en: Normal procedures such as spin recovery techniques may also be included in this Section of an acrobatic category airplane Handbook.
20.zh: 特技类飞机的《飞行员操作手册》的该节内容还可以包含诸如螺旋改出技术在内的正常程序。

20.en: For landing distance, both ground roll and the total distance over a 50 foot obstacle shall be included.
20.zh: 对于着陆距离，应包括地面滑跑和超过50英尺障碍物的总距离。

20.en: Maximum Landing Gear Extended Speed is the maximum speed at which an aircraft can be safely flown with the landing gear extended.
20.zh: 最大起落架放下速度是指起落架放下状态下飞机可以安全飞行的最大速度。

20.en: The generators supply a three-phase voltage. The frequency of this voltage increases when the generator rotor speed increases.
20.zh: 发电机提供三相电压。当发电机转子速度升高时，此电压的频率会增加。

20.en: Overhaul of propellers must be accomplished in a qualified shop in accordance with data supplied by the propeller manufacturer.
20.zh: 螺旋桨的大修必须按照螺旋桨制造商提供的数据在合格的车间中完成。

20.en: Move the seat forward or aft approximately 0.50 in. (12.70 mm) to align the flanges on the seat track fittings with the holes in the seat tracks.
20.zh: 向前或后移动座椅大约0.50英寸（12.70毫米）使座椅滑轨接头上的凸缘与座椅滑轨里的孔对齐。

20.en: If there is no hydraulic power to extend the nose gear, the weight of the gear and the airstream pushes the nose gear into the extended position.
20.zh: 如果没有液压动力放下前起落架，起落架的重量和气流会将其推至放下位。

20.en: The repair must be examined at specified intervals and replaced if deterioration or damage is found.
20.zh: 必须在规定的间隔内对修理进行检验，如发现老化或损坏，则必须更换。

20.en: When you do the lifting or lowering of the aircraft, make sure that the persons who operate the lifting/lowering equipment have the correct training and knowledge.
20.zh: 在升降飞机时，要确保操作升降设备的人员接受过恰当的培训并具备相应的知识。

20.en: Keep the elevator from moving by installing a wooden block between the inboard edge of the elevator and the tail cone.
20.zh: 在升降舵内侧和尾锥之间放置一个木块，以防止升降舵移动。

20.en: If the indications do not clearly show that a fastener is loose, make a red line across the head and the adjacent material.
20.zh: 如果没有明显迹象表明紧固件松动，在紧固件头部和相邻材料上标记一条红线。

20.en: Three computers collect data and parameters from the systems and put them together on the data link to the display unit.
20.zh: 三台计算机收集系统数据和参数，并通过数据链接将它们一起传送给显示组件。

20.en: A list of corresponding serial/unit numbers (or other identifying information) is in a corresponding column on the right side of the page.
20.zh: 页面右侧相应的栏目中列出了对应的序列号/组件号(或其他识别信息)。

20.en: If the airplane has a built-in auxiliary power unit, describe it and explain how it fits in with the electrical system.
20.zh: 如果飞机有一个内置的辅助动力装置，描述该装置并解释它是如何配合电气系统工作的.

20.en: The procedures shall clearly describe the step-by-step operation in a logical work flow sequence as necessary to gain access to and subsequently remove the hardware or install the hardware.
20.zh: 该程序应按照逻辑工作流程顺序，按需清楚地描述逐步操作，以接近并随后移除或安装硬件。

20.en: If the wheel temperature increases to more than 177 deg., the core of the fusible plug melts and the tire deflates.
20.zh: 如果机轮温度升高到177度以上，易熔塞中心熔化，轮胎会漏气。

20.en: Definitions should be worded as simply as possible and must conform with the use of the defined terms in the Handbook.
20.zh: 定义措辞应尽可能简单，并必须符合手册中所定义的术语的使用。

20.en: The slow moving, high pressure air from the compressor is fed into the combustor where it is mixed with a highly flammable fuel and ignited.
20.zh: 来自压气机的缓慢移动的高压气体进入燃烧室，与易燃燃料混合并点燃。

21.en: Limitations associated with optional systems may be included in this section.
21.en2: Limitations related to optional systems may be contained in this section.

21.en: The airplanes were delivered with recommended inspection programs to keep them airworthy.
21.en2: The airplanes are airworthy because they were delivered in accordance with advised inspection procedures.

21.en: Briefly describe and explain principle of operation of any new kinds of flight instruments.
21.zh: 简要描述和说明各种新型飞行仪表的工作原理。

21.en: Explain how to check them for proper operation and how to recognize a malfunction.
21.zh: 解释如何检查它们是否正常运行，以及如何识别故障。

21.en: The STE dictionary gives an approved alternative that has a different part of speech.
21.zh: STE词典给出了一个经过批准的有不同词性的替代词。

21.en: In some cases, wires are color coded and these should be indicated on the wiring diagram.
21.zh: 在某些情况下，电线有颜色编码，这些应该在线路图上标明。

21.en: The Abnormal Procedures Section shall include, at the beginning, a check list with regard to order of action when sequence is essential to safety.
21.zh: 当顺序对安全至关重要时，异常程序部分在开始时应包括一份有关操作顺序的检查单。

21.en: The manufacturer recommends that you prepare the mixture in an area with good airflow.
21.zh: 制造商建议您在气流良好的区域制备混合物。

21.en: The hot battery bus usually receives power from the main battery or main battery charger.
21.zh: 热电池汇流条通常从主电池或者主电池充电器中获得动力。

21.en: The alphanumeric display shows only voltage and frequency when you select one of these pushbutton.
21.zh: 当你选择这些按钮中的其一时，数字字母显示只出现电压和频率。

21.en: Maximum Operating Limit Speed is the speed limit that may not be deliberately exceeded in normal flight operations.
21.zh: 最大运行极限速度是指在正常飞行中不能故意超过的速度限制。

21.en: The originators of the change forms are usually notified of the related STEMG assessments and decisions.
21.zh: 变更表格的发起者通常会被通知相关的STEMG评估和决定。

21.en: If the Check List lists "engine run-up", the amplified procedures would explain how to perform the run-up.
21.zh: 如果检查单中包含“发动机试车”检查项，扩展程序将解释如何实施试车。

21.en: The applicable regulations for any specific airplane, which may differ from the referenced FAR, must be followed.
21.zh: 任何特殊飞机所适用的规定都必须遵守，尽管这些规定可能与引用的FAR不同。

21.en: Revisions are to be made consistent with the format of their specification using the provisions of FAR 21.50 as a basis.
21.zh: 修订应以FAR 21.50规定为基础，与其规范的格式一致。

21.en: A separate shading pattern to distinguish between supply, pressure, return, etc., shall be used. The same coding for each individual system shall be used throughout the manual.
21.zh: 应使用单独的阴影模式来区分供应、压力、返回等。每个单独的系统应在整个手册中使用相同的编码。

21.en: Fig.1 in pages 11 and 12 are typical plating/skin illustrations as specified in System Chapters 53,54, 55 and 57.
21.zh: 第11和12页中的图1是53章、54章、55章和57章中典型的镀层/蒙皮插图。

21.en: The Check List may also contain supplemental information pertinent to the operation of the airplane, such as performance data, optional equipment operation, etc., that the pilot might routinely use.
21.zh: 检查单还可能包含与飞机操作相关的补充信息，如性能数据、可选设备操作等，飞行员可能会经常使用。

21.en: In addition, it shall provide definitions or explanations of symbols, abbreviations, and terminology used in the Handbook.
21.zh: 另外，它应提供手册中使用的符号、缩略语和术语的定义或解释。

21.en: Once designed and approved, the establishment of thorough maintenance procedures is a must.
21.zh: 一旦设计和批准，必须建立详尽的维修程序。

21.en: The approved repair portion shall include processes and techniques necessary for performing a repair.
21.zh: 批准的修理部分应包括执行修理所需的工艺和技术。

21.en: Continuing Airworthiness Program inspections usually consist of two pages: one text page and one illustration page.
21.zh: 持续适航程序检查通常包括两页：一个文本页和一个图解页。

21.en: This chapter includes engaging, sensing, computing, amplifying, controlling, actuating and warning devices.
21.zh: 此章节包括了接通、感应、计算、放大、控制、作动和警告装置。

21.en: The schematic diagrams should include generators, tanks and reservoirs that are considered to be the starting points of the flow.
21.zh: 原理图应包括被认为是输出源头的发电机、油箱和储液箱。

21.en: This task checks to make sure that the interphone communication between the flight crew and the attendants operates correctly.
21.zh: 此任务检查用于确认飞行人员与乘务员之间的内话通讯正常工作。

21.en: The Type Certificate will not be issued to the applicant unless the findings are completely settled.
21.zh: 如果发现的问题得不到彻底解决，就不会向申请方颁发型号合格证。

21.en: Make sure that the position of the clamp agrees with the position that you recorded during the removal procedure.
21.zh: 确保夹钳的位置与您在拆卸过程中记录的位置一致。

21.en: The manufacturer may establish procedures to provide feedback on unairworthy conditions that were discovered when complying.
21.zh: 制造商可以建立程序，对在遵守时发现的不适航的状况提供反馈。

21.en: List the tools, equipment and materials required in the job which are not normally included in the mechanic's tools.
21.zh: 列出机械员工具箱内通常不包含的工作所需的工具、设备和器材。

21.en: WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE POTABLE WATER SYSTEM IS NOT PRESSURIZED. A PRESSURIZED SYSTEM CAN CAUSE INJURY TO PERSONS.
21.zh: 警告：确保饮用水系统未加压。加压系统可能会造成人身伤害。

22.en: The operator uses an external joystick and control panel to set the configuration and operate the system.
22.en2: In order to set the configuration and operate the system, the operator uses an external joystick and control panel.

22.en: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably adhere to the Specification content and arrangement.
22.en2: Each manufacturer is expected to reasonably abide by the Specification content and arrangement.

22.en: The lanyard attached to the after end of the right access door to the APU compartment is frayed.
22.zh: APU舱右侧接近门后端系留绳断丝。

22.en: Miscellaneous category consists of many parts and components, five kinds of these parts have been selected.
22.zh: 杂项类别包含很多种部件或零件，我们选择了其中五种。

22.en: The inlet door actuator is installed aft of the rear pressure bulkhead on the inner side of the air inlet door.
22.zh: 引气口作动器安装在进气门内侧的后压力舱壁的后部。

22.en: The clocks get power from the 28v dc hot battery bus through the CLOCK circuit breaker.
22.zh: 时钟通过CLOCK跳开关从28伏直流热电瓶汇流条中获取电源。

22.en: Torquemeter is an indicating system that displays the output torque available on the propeller shaft.
22.zh: 扭矩测量仪是一个显示螺旋桨传动轴可用输出扭矩的指示系统。

22.en: In addition, this section may contain a comprehensive list of equipment available for installation by the manufacturer.
22.zh: 此外，本节可能包含可以由制造商来安装的设备的综合清单。

22.en: The primary document containing the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of an airplane is the airplane's maintenance manual.
22.zh: 包含飞机持续适航程序的主要文件是飞机维修手册。

22.en: The technical reference document contains a list of necessary document, such as Service Bulletin, Service Letter and etc.
22.zh: 技术参考文件包括必要的文件清单，如服务通告、服务信函等。

22.en: Always obey the precautions that follow to keep electrical wiring in a satisfactory condition.
22.zh: 始终遵守如下预防措施以保持电线处于良好状况。

22.en: Remove the protective layer from one side of the new gasket with ANTENNA SIDE markings.
22.zh: 从新垫圈上标有"ANTENNA SIDE"的一侧，撕掉保护膜。

22.en: The primary function of the hydraulic pressure system is to supply pressure for the operation of the flight controls.
22.zh: 液压系统的主要功能是为飞行控制系统的操作提供压力。

22.en: Procedures shall be provided for all airplanes for all cases of engine failure during takeoff and in flight.
22.zh: 对于所有飞机在起飞和飞行过程中发生的所有发动机故障，应提供相应的程序。

22.en: If it is possible that the temperature values will be more than the permitted limits, decrease the power.
22.zh: 如果温度值可能超过允许的限度，降低功率。

22.en: Each item of Airplane Performance shall include a statement of significant conditions associated with the data.
22.zh: 飞机性能的每一项应包括与数据有关的重要条件的说明。

22.en: All flow control devices, such as check valves, fuel pumps, accumulators, should be included.
22.zh: 所有的流量控制装置应该包含在内，如单向活门、燃油泵、蓄压器。

22.en: Existing analyses were reviewed to identify components and areas that may have exhibited lower margins of safety.
22.zh: 对现有的分析进行了审查，以确定可能存在安全裕度较低的部件和区域。

22.en: Braking system is used to decrease run-down time or stop propeller rotation during engine power-off conditions.
22.zh: 制动系统是用来减少停车时间或在发动机关车的情况下使螺旋桨停止转动。

22.en: If a company publication style manual is used, the format and layout should follow this Specification to the extent practicable.
22.zh: 如果使用一个公司出版样式的手册，那么手册的格式和布局应当遵循本规范。

22.en: A CAP is the primary document containing the procedures for the continuing airworthiness of the airplane.
22.zh: CAP是包含飞机持续适航程序的主要文件。

22.en: The Preface contains the relationship of the CAP to normal inspection programs for the product.
22.zh: 前言中包含CAP与产品正常检验程序的关系。

22.en: Remember that the primary objective of STE is that readers immediately understand each sentence that they read.
22.zh: 记住,STE的主要目的是让读者能够立即理解他们所读到的每一句话。

22.en: Verbs are given in the forms that are permitted. Do not use verb forms that are not listed.
22.zh: 给出了动词允许使用的形式。不要使用未列出的动词形式。

22.en: “Decrease” is better because it describes the pressure, not the indicator that monitors the pressure.
22.zh: 使用“降低”更好，因为它描述的是压力，而不是监测压力的指示器。

22.en: The Check List may also contain supplemental information pertinent to the operation of the airplane.
22.zh: 检查单可能也包括关于飞机操作的补充信息。

22.en: This Specification has been developed in response to Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Advisory Circular.
22.zh: 本规范是根据联邦航空管理局的咨询通告而制定的。

22.en: No part of this document may be reproduced in any form without permission in writing from the publisher.
22.zh: 未经出版商书面许可， 本文件任何部分不得以任何形式复制。

22.en: Brake system explains how to recognize impending problems and what to do if malfunctions occur.
22.zh: 刹车系统解释了如何识别即将出现的问题以及如果发生故障怎么办。

22.en: Descriptive Data shall be supplied for standard and optional engine and propeller installations and fuel and oil systems.
22.zh: 对于标准和选装的发动机和螺旋桨装置以及燃油和滑油系统，应提供描述性数据。

23.en: No legal significance or implications should be attached to the rules and terms in this document.
23.en2: The rules and terms in this document have no legal meaning or imply something.

23.en: Get the correct tools to open the containers for these materials.
23.en2: To open the containers for these materials, suitable tools must be used.

23.en: The APU fire warning system activates the same fire warning in the cockpit as for the engines.
23.zh: APU火警系统在驾驶舱内启动与发动机相同的火警警报。

23.en: Make sure that the position of the clamp agrees with the position that you recorded during the removal procedure.
23.zh: 确保卡箍位置与拆卸过程中记录的位置保持一致。

23.en: Remove all the rigging pins and equipment that prevent free movement of the control surfaces.
23.zh: 移除所有的防止操纵面自由运动的校装销和设备。

23.en: The condition of the radome is very important for its performance.
23.zh: 雷达罩的状况对其性能有着重要的影响。

23.en: Personnel must be familiar with the emergency safety procedures prior to using the material.
23.zh: 在使用材料之前，人员必须熟悉紧急安全程序。

23.en: Being able to reduce friction, ball bearings are used extensively in many kinds of modern aircraft.
23.zh: 因为可以减小摩擦力，滚珠轴承广泛应用于现代飞机。

23.en: Definitions or explanations of symbols, abbreviations, and terminology used in the Handbook should be provided.
23.zh: 应该提供手册中使用的符号、缩略语和术语的定义或解释。

23.en: The most common mistakes in performing the adverse loading checks are failure to convert the oil from quarts to gallons.
23.zh: 在极限装载检查中，最常见的的错误是没有将滑油单位从夸脱转换成加仑。

23.en: The airframe manufacturer will incorporate into the Maintenance Manual, where appropriate, the "shared interest" data supplied by component manufacturers.
23.zh: 机身制造商在维修手册中适当的部分会加入部件制造商提供的“共同利益”数据。

23.en: Loosen the air valve nut one or two turns to slowly release the air pressure. Drain hydraulic fluid by inverting shock strut or removing check valve.
23.zh: 拧松气阀螺母一两圈，慢慢释放气压。通过反转减震支柱或拆除单向活门排放液压油。

23.en: The assembly extends through the casing assemblies and is connected to the telescopic control assembly.
23.zh: 组件延伸至壳体组件，并与伸缩控制组件相连。

23.en: The circulation of the air in the components is such that the temperature for specific component is not out of the limit.
23.zh: 该部件中的空气循环使得特定部件的温度不超限。

23.en: The ozone converter prevents damage to the air separation module from oxidation of the membrane material by ozone.
23.zh: 臭氧转换器防止臭氧对膜材料进行氧化，从而避免空气分离模块受损。

23.en: If the maintenance message does not show in CURRENT STATUS, then there was an intermittent fault.
23.zh: 如果维护信息未在"当前状态"中显示，则出现了间歇性故障。

23.en: If the format parameter or rule is inappropriate to the type of airplane, equivalents likely to achieve the same objective may be used.
23.zh: 如果格式参数或规则不适合于飞机的类型，则可以使用可能达到相同目的的对等物。

23.en: identify a revision to an illustration with a black vertical line in the left margin opposite the revised portion or use a "pointing hand".
23.zh: 用与修改部分相对的左边空白处的黑色垂直线或用“手形指示”来确定插图的修改。

23.en: Turbine engine tachometers usually measure speed as a percentage of the nominal maximum speed of the turbines.
23.zh: 涡轮发动机转速表通常以涡轮额定最大转速的百分比来测量转速。

23.en: Our purpose is to provide consistent, industry standardized Continuing Airworthiness Programs.
23.zh: 我们的目的是提供一致的、行业标准化的持续适航方案。

23.en: The additional information may be imparted to existing employees through the recurrent training requirements.
23.zh: 增加的信息可以通过复训要求传达给现有员工。

23.en: Operation time must be 28 to 40 seconds in either direction and operation current must not exceed 0.5 A.
23.zh: 在任何一个方向上作动的时间必须在28至40秒之间，且作动电流不得超过0.5安培。

23.en: Each page must bear the date of the original issue until revised and, when revised, that of the latest revision.
23.zh: 每一页都必须标明原始版本的出版日期，直到修订为止。当有修订时，也必须标明最新修订版的出版日期。

23.en: CORROSION INHIBITING COMPOUND MAY BE PRESENT IN CORROSION SUSCEPTIBLE LOCATIONS.
23.zh: 易受腐蚀的部位可能有防腐剂。

23.en: The OEUs change 115v AC from the main bus to 5v AC for row call lights and 12v AC for the reading lights.
23.zh: OEUs将来自主汇流条的115V交流电转换成用于排呼叫灯的5V交流电和用于阅读灯的12V交流电。

23.en: Terms that contain a capital letter plus a noun, or a number plus a noun usually describe the shape or configuration of something.
23.zh: 包含大写字母加名词或数字加名词的术语，通常用于描述某物的形状或结构。

23.en: The difference between an "emergency" and "abnormal" situation may also depend on the circumstances of flight.
23.zh: "紧急"情况和"异常"情况之间的区别也可能取决于飞行时的情况。

23.en: Any limits on Maximum Passenger Seating, by number of passengers or specific restrictions on seat occupancy, shall be stated.
23.zh: 针对最大乘客座位数量的任何限制都应加以说明，包括乘客人数或座位占用的具体限制。

23.en: The CAP is not intended to change or replace any portion of the applicable airplane Maintenance Manual or Service Letters.
23.zh: 建立CAP的意图并不是要改变或取代适用的飞机维修手册或服务信函的任何部分。

23.en: The purpose of the antiskating foil is to help reduce any noise made by the air as it passes through the valve.
23.zh: 防滑箔的目的是帮助降低空气流经活门时产生的噪音。

24.en: Identify the bell crank and shaft with marks to prevent incorrect installation.
24.en2: Mark the bell crank and shaft so that they'll be identified and incorrect installation will not occur.

24.en: Advisory circular is information provided by FAA that is not mandatory.
24.en2: FAA provides advisory circular which is not always carried out on aircraft.

24.en: Maximum Operating Limit Speed is the speed limit that may not be deliberately exceeded in normal flight operations. V is expressed in knots and M in Mach Number.
24.zh: 最大操作限制速度是指在正常飞行操作中不得故意超过的速度限制。V用节表示，M用马赫数表示。

24.en: On some turbopropeller powered airplanes, the condition lever is the primary control for starting and stopping the engine. On others, it is the primary control used to set engine and propeller speed.
24.zh: 在某些涡轮螺旋桨驱动的飞机上，状态杆是发动机启动和停车的主要控制装置。在其它类型的飞机上，状态杆主要用来控制设置发动机和螺旋桨速度。

24.en: Engine Operating Limits include limits for Take off Power, Maximum Continuous Power, and Maximum Normal Operating Power.
24.zh: 发动机运行限制包括起飞功率限制、最大连续功率限制以及最大正常运行功率限制。

24.en: The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes, including power plant cowling anti-icing.
24.zh: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止进气道内部或周围积冰，包含动力装置整流罩防冰装置。

24.en: Fault isolation manual provides the information used to identify, locate and correct any fault that might occur on the airplane.
24.zh: 故障隔离手册提供的信息可以用来标识、定位和纠正可能在飞机上发生的任何故障。

24.en: The flight data recorder system gets and stores airplane parameters from airplane systems and sensors.
24.zh: 飞行数据记录器系统从飞机系统和传感器获得并存储飞机参数。

24.en: Use a word that is unapproved in the dictionary only when it is a technical name or part of a technical name.
24.zh: 对于词典中未批准的词,只有当它是技术名称或技术名称的一部分时才可以使用。

24.en: Where possible and practicable, quotation marks shall be removed from the text of the definitions and approved examples.
24.zh: 在可能和可行的情况下，将引号从定义和批准示例的文本中删除。

24.en: Technical texts often contain long groups of words that have the function of one part of speech in a sentence.
24.zh: 技术文本常常包含很长的词组，这些词组在一个句子中具有一种词性的功能。

24.en: For the remaining non-complex items, the airframe manufacturer will incorporate information as part of the manual.
24.zh: 对于剩余的非复杂项目，机体制造商将信息并入作为手册的一部分。

24.en: Reserve shall be computed as 45 minutes at the cruise power to be used for the flight.
24.zh: 航班所需的储备燃油量应为巡航功率下45分钟所使用的燃油量。

24.en: Measure the bend radius of the hose from the point where the bend starts.
24.zh: 从软管开始弯曲的地方测量软管的弯曲半径。

24.en: Wing and power loading is based on the Maximum Takeoff Weight and the Takeoff Horsepower Rating and the Wing Area.
24.zh: 机翼和发动机载荷取决于最大起飞重量和额定起飞马力以及机翼面积。

24.en: If possible, supply sufficient examples from your technical documentation to support your proposal.
24.zh: 如果可能，从技术文件中提供充分的示例来支持您的提议。

24.en: When you replace a word, always make sure that the alternative you select does not change the meaning of the sentence.
24.zh: 当你替换一个词时，一定要确保你选择的替代词不会改变句子的意思。

24.en: When there is no technical name in approved nomenclature, select one that is short and easy to understand.
24.zh: 当批准的术语中没有技术名称时，选择一个简短易懂的名称。

24.en: This torque shaft cannot move inboard. Thus, before you remove it, remove the outboard torque shaft.
24.zh: 该扭力轴不能向内侧移动，因此在拆下之前，应先拆下外侧扭力轴。

24.en: Illustrations should be used whenever they will simplify, shorten, or make the text easier to understand.
24.zh: 如果能简化、缩短文本或能使文本更容易理解，则应使用插图。

24.en: The main frame of the wing includes spars, ribs, stringers, integral fuel tank structure, tip tank supporting structure and frames around openings.
24.zh: 大翼的主要结构框架包括梁、肋、桁条、燃油箱整体结构、翼尖油箱支撑结构和开口周围结构。

24.en: Acetone is a heavy-duty degreaser suitable for metal preparation and removing grease from fabric covering prior to doping.
24.zh: 丙酮是重度油污去除剂，适合金属表面预处理和织物蒙皮喷漆前去油。

24.en: The two most common types of engines used in helicopters are the reciprocating engine and the turbine engine.
24.zh: 直升机最常用的两类发动机是活塞发动机和涡轮发动机。

24.en: The index should show the chapter and subchapter in which a circuit of the system appears.
24.zh: 索引应显示系统电路所在的章或子章。

24.en: The function and operation of each unit in the system should be described as well as the location of the units.
24.zh: 应描述系统中每个组件的功能、操作以及位置。

24.en: If the danger is clearly specified, the person who does the task will understand the risk and be more careful.
24.zh: 如果清楚说明了危险，执行任务的人就会了解风险，且更加小心。

24.en: Correct punctuation is important because it shows how the different parts of the text are related and prevents ambiguity.
24.zh: 正确的标点符号很重要，因为它表明了文本的不同部分是如何联系在一起的，并防止了歧义。

24.en: Outlets along the side walls and the center of the ceiling divide the air for symmetrical supply.
24.zh: 为了供应对称均衡，沿着侧壁和天花板中心的出口将空气分离。

24.en: The passenger cabin exhaust air goes through floor grilles to the recirculation system or overboard.
24.zh: 旅客客舱排气途经地板格栅到再循环系统或者头顶板。

24.en: The system design makes sure that two AC power sources can not supply power to the same transfer bus at the same time.
24.zh: 系统设计确保两个交流电源不能同时供应动力给同样的转换汇流条。

25.en: A high standard of professionalism is necessary to use the STE specification correctly.
25.en2: If you want to use the STE specification properly, a high professional standard is required.

25.en: Procedure requires a breakdown of the job into logical steps or operations.
25.en2: Break down maintenance activities into logical steps or operations as required by procedures.

25.en: The portion of the system is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces, including wings and airfoil sections of the empennage.
25.zh: 系统的这个部分能够消除或阻止所有翼型表面积冰,包括机翼和尾翼的翼面部分。

25.en: Those units and components provide for external and internal illumination such as landing lights, taxi lights, position lights, rotating lights, ice lights, cabin warning lights, passenger reading and cabin dome lights, etc.
25.zh: 这些组件和部件能够提供外部和内部照明，包括着陆灯、滑行灯、航行灯、旋转式信号灯、积冰信号灯、主警告灯、乘客阅读灯和机舱顶灯等。

25.en: Landing and Taxiing Aids include items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, ground guidance systems, etc.
25.zh: 着陆和滑行助航设备包括航向道、下滑道、仪表着陆系统、信标、地面制导系统等项目。

25.en: Dependent Position Determining includes items such as DME, transponders, radio compass, LORAN, VOR, ADF, etc.
25.zh: 相关位置确定包括测距仪、应答机、无线电罗盘、罗兰、甚高频全向信标台、自动定向仪等部件。

25.en: The primary document containing the procedures for the continued airworthiness of an airplane is the airplane's maintenance manual.
25.zh: 包含飞机持续适航程序的主要文件是飞机的维修手册。

25.en: Other procedures essential or pertinent to the operation of the airplane may be included in the Handbook.
25.zh: 与飞机操作有关或必要的其他程序可包括在手册中。

25.en: Fuel required includes the fuel used for engine start, taxi, takeoff, normal climb, descent and 45 minutes reserve.
25.zh: 所需燃油包括用于发动机启动、滑行、起飞、正常爬升、下降和45分钟备用的燃油。

25.en: This document gives the different torque values and the conditions where they are applicable.
25.zh: 本文件给出了不同的扭矩值和其适用的条件。

25.en: Gauges used to indicate lower pressures use a more flexible tube that uncoils and coils more readily.
25.zh: 用于指示低压的压力计使用更灵活的管子，更容易展开和卷绕。

25.en: One characteristic of the component is preventing its axis of rotation tilting as the earth rotates.
25.zh: 该部件的一个特性是防止其旋转轴随着地球自转而倾斜。

25.en: Only when both manufacturer and operator do their job can remain an entire fleet of airplanes continuously airworthy.
25.zh: 只有制造商和运营商共同努力，才能保持整个飞机机队持续适航。

25.en: Existing analyses were reviewed to identify components and areas that may have exhibited lower margins of safety.
25.zh: 对现有分析进行了审查，以确定可能显示出较低安全裕度的组件和区域。

25.en: Close inspection in cable critical fatigue areas can be performed by rubbing a rag along the cable.
25.zh: 可以通过使用抹布沿钢索擦拭的方法，实现对钢索关键疲劳区域的仔细检查。

25.en: For ease of reading and cross reference, illustrations, figures and tables should be presented in a vertical layout, if practical.
25.zh: 为了便于阅读和相互参考，插图、图形和表格如果可行的话，应以垂直布局呈现。

25.en: NOTE: During the subsequent test, you get the cracking pressure when the fuel flow from the CROSS FEED port is more than 5 cc/minute.
25.zh: 注：在随后的测试中，当来自交输进口的燃油流量超过5 毫升/分钟时，你将获得开启压力。

25.en: During the approach to the runway, deviation pointers in the course indicators show the pilot in which direction the aircraft must go.
25.zh: 在接近跑道的过程中，航向指示器中的偏离指示器指示飞行员飞机必须飞行的方向。

25.en: When the preset threshold is reached, the smoke detector triggers a warning via the Cabin Intercommunication Data System.
25.zh: 当达到预设阈值时，烟雾探测器通过客舱内部通信数据系统触发警告。

25.en: Record the location and the color of the cables of each bundle which goes through the AC current transformer.
25.zh: 记录穿过交流电流互感器的每束电缆的位置和颜色。

25.en: Notes call attention to methods which make the job easier, or provide supplementary or explanatory information.
25.zh: 注释提醒注意使工作更容易的方法，或提供补充或解释信息的方法。

25.en: These tests may require supplemental ground support equipment and should be more specific and detailed than an operational test.
25.zh: 这些测试可能需要额外的地面支持设备，应比操作测试更具体和详细。

25.en: These actuators control the movement of the ailerons and elevators, which control the flight path of the airplane.
25.zh: 这些作动器控制副翼和升降舵的运动，副翼和升降舵控制飞机的飞行路径。

25.en: This manual includes procedures such as periodic engine running, control or drainage of fluid systems, static grounding, etc.
25.zh: 本手册包括定期发动机试车、油液系统控制或排放、静电接地等程序。

25.en: Outside Air Temperature is obtained either from inflight temperature indications or ground meteorological sources.
25.zh: 外部气温可以通过空中温度指示或地面气象源获取。

25.en: It is implied that the inspection will include observation and evaluation of the surrounding area of parts and equipment.
25.zh: 这意味着检查将包括对部件及设备周围区域进行的观察和评估。

25.en: Turbine engine tachometers usually measure speed as a percentage of the nominal maximum speed of the turbine(s).
25.zh: 通常，涡轮发动机转速计会以涡轮额定最大转速的百分比测量转速。

25.en: Differences in design and complexity of the various types and models of airplanes play a major role in a specific malfunction.
25.zh: 设计上的差异以及各种类型和型号的飞机的复杂性都对一个具体故障产生很大影响。

25.en: Engine analyzers are used to analyze engine performance or condition by means of instruments or devices such as oscilloscopes, etc.
25.zh: 发动机分析仪的功能是通过示波器等仪表或设备分析发动机性能或状态。

25.en: Wing and power loading is based on the Maximum Takeoff Weight and the Takeoff Horsepower Rating and the Wing Area.
25.zh: 机翼和发动机载荷取决于最大起飞重量和额定起飞马力以及机翼面积。
